en.description:
Dive into “The Wrist Rush” on Apple Watch! Rapid-fire mini-games: collect coins, unlock new challenges, and master the digital crown controls!

WELCOME TO “THE WRIST RUSH”:

-Mini-games designed for your Apple Watch
-Experience a dynamic & engaging new mini-game every 10 seconds
-Collect coins as you go to unlock more games
-Play anytime, anywhere, right on your wrist!
Here’s a sneak peek into some of the mini-games you’ll encounter:
ORANGE’S UP: Keep the orange jumping but don’t let it fall. Control with quick rotations of the digital crown.
WATCHIUS: Navigate through space and avoid cosmic adversaries with careful crown rotations
FLYGUIN: Assist jumping penguins with strategic crown rotations to avoid obstacles
BUBBLICIOUS: Help Holly control bubble gum sizes, maintaining the goal size with precise crown rotations
FLANKY GHOST: Guide Flanky the Ghost through obstacles with timely crown movements
CANNON’ON: Aim and extinguish flames to save the day, using the crown for aiming
ABYSS?: Dive into the abyss in search of treasures, controlling your descent with the crown
FISHING, YES: Fish for treasures while avoiding fish, controlling your hook with the crown
VIKING HARBOR: Direct blind sailors by moving a light source with the crown
KING’S TRAINING: Help the king in his training by intercepting cannon shots, moving up or down with the crown
HIGHWAY CHASE: Drive a car in a thrilling chase, avoiding obstacles with crown rotations
A UNIQUE ADVENTURE:
Each mini-game in “The Wrist Rush” offers different levels of difficulty and requires various skills. The coins you collect can be used to unlock these games permanently, adding them to your gameplay rotation.
MORE THAN A GAME:
“The Wrist Rush” is a series of captivating challenges that you can PLAY ANYTIME, ANYWHERE, RIGHT ON YOUR WRIST!
Get ready for non-stop fun & excitement with “The Wrist Rush”!

Payments and Renewal:
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Account settings at any time after purchase
No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active period.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://starrynight-ac70a.web.app/privacyp.html
